translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Hebreos
book.title: Kart daa bseḻ' to beṉ' lao beṉ' hebreoka', beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona'

content: Daan, chonan byen wzenagchcho do yic̱hj do lall'cho dill' wen dill' koba' daa ba benicho kwenc̱he bi ḻaacho lo xṉeze'na'.
Ḻa' diika' bllia Chioza' bia' goncho, diika' wdix̱jee anjlka', gokgakan to dii zakii, na' yog' beṉ'ka' wdishjgake' cho'a xtilleena' na' bi bzenaggake'n wxak'zi'gake' kon ka chiyaḻ' gak c̱hegake'.

¿Alechlə ṉaa aga wilacho lao yeḻ' zak'zi'na' shi gonicho nakzi daa nak to dii zakii nlleb daa ba ben Chioza' c̱hecho kwenc̱he yisle' cho' na' bi kwiayi'cho? Zigaate X̱ancho Jesúza' wdix̱ji'e daa yisle' cho', na'tech beṉ'ka' bzenag c̱he' bizc̱hopgake' dillaa bi'e.

Na' ḻekzka' Chioza' bli'e nan nakan dii ḻi daa bene' ka ben beṉ'ka' dii zan yeḻ' wak na' dii chon ka chibanicho, na' bseḻee Espíritu Santo c̱he'na' beṉe' wde wdeli dii gak gon to tocho kon ka chaklall' Chioza'.
Aga bllia Chioza' bia' iṉabia' anjlka' lo yell-lio koba' daa ba ngwee xṉezin gone', dga cho'a dill' c̱heyin ṉaa.
San nakan ka wna to beṉ' bzej Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' kani'yi daa na:

content.text: ¿Nora naknto', neto' beṉ' yell-lio, chi' yic̱hjzo' neto',
na' zezo' wṉeyi c̱he neto' naknto' xiiṉ beṉec̱h?
Zi lat'zə ki beno' neto' ka anjl c̱ho'ka',
na' noṉo' neto' to balaaṉ xen wal.
Na' bzo' neto' iṉabia'nto' lao yog'te diika' beno'.

content: Na' daa bene' lall' na' beṉ' yell-lioni yog'ḻoḻ dii de, zejin aga bi de dii bi gak lall' na'cho, ḻa'kzi ṉaa biṉ' ile'icho gak yog'ḻoḻ dii de lall' na'cho.

Per ṉezicho Jesúza' ba yo'e to balaaṉ xen wal, ḻa'kzi bi bllin sakee ka anjlka' shlak wde' lo yell-lioni goke' beṉec̱h kwenc̱he wxak'zi'e na' wite' ni c̱hecho. Ḻa' daa nak Chioza' beṉ' wenan, bzanile'ne' ble'ile' yeḻ' wita' lo laz yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'.

Dii ḻi, Chioza', beena' bx̱e bsil yog'ḻoḻte dii de na' nakgakan c̱he', cheenile' beṉ' be beṉ' zil gakgake' xiiṉe' kwenc̱he yic̱hi'e ḻegake' gana' de balaaṉ xen c̱he'na'. Daan, benan byen bzanile' Jesúza' wxak'zi'e na' wite' kwenc̱he bisle' cho'. Na' ka', biyoll bido bene' yog'ḻoḻ daa nllia Chioza' bia' gone'.
Jesúza', beena' ba bix̱is biyibe' cho', na' cho' ba bixi biyechcho, toz X̱achon nak. Daan, bi chiyiyi Jesucrístona' iṉe' nakcho bish' ljwelle'.

content.text: Wi'a dill' c̱ho' lao bish' ljwell'ka',
na' goḻ iṉia' li' ladj beṉ'ka' chdop chllag choe'la'ogake' li'.
Ni zoalen' beṉ'ki nak xiiṉ Chioza', beṉ'ki bene' lall' na'.

content: Na' daa nak xiiṉe'ka' beṉ' de beli chen, ḻekzka' Jesúza' golje' goke' beṉ' de beli chen kwenc̱he wite' ni c̱hecho. Na' ka wite', bsol bṉite' yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he dii x̱iwaa daa gok lall' na'yin wlliayi'n beṉ'.
Na' bisle' cho' beṉ' yell-lio, cho' nakcho ka beṉ' ndoo lao yeḻ' wita' shlak mbancho daa chllebcho guetcho.
Ḻa' dii ḻi, aga bid Jesúza' kwenc̱he gaklene' anjlkan', san kwenc̱he gaklene' xiiṉ dia c̱he dii Abrahaman'.

Daan, benan byen goke' beṉ' de beli chen doxen ka nakcho, cho' bish' ljwelle', kwenc̱he yiyesh'lallile' cho' na' soe' gone' ka ben Chioza' lo nee gone' daa nake' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen c̱hecho. Na' bzani kwine' wite' kwenc̱he bizi'xen Chioza' saaxya c̱hechoka'.
Na' daa bizo bizakile' btiḻe' daa nan kooyeḻaan ḻe' bi gone' ka cheeni Chioza', wak gaklene' cho' kat' za' daa cheenin kooyeḻaan cho' goncho daa bi chazlall' Chioza'.
